description: Restore the colour ratios of a reference view in the bright areas of a target, in place, keeping the target's luminance. Per channel: restored = min(reference[c] * Lt / max(Lr, 0.001), max_value), where Lt and Lr are the target's and the reference's channel means; it is weighted in linearly from 0 at reference luminance restore_start to 1 at restore_end. Runs as 64-bit PixelMath truncated to [0,1]; reports the target's median and max before and after.

max_value.description: Upper cap on each restored channel

pre_star_id.description: Reference RGB view whose colour ratios are restored (open, same dimensions)

restore_end.description: Reference luminance at and above which the restored colour fully replaces the target; greater than restore_start

restore_start.description: Reference luminance at and below which the target is unchanged

target_id.description: RGB view to modify in place

name: restore_star_color
